name: M1 scenario 2: an alert defined by a zone shape, the place close to the edge
note: The zone FLC015 from the committed fixture, 2962 vertices, which is the shape about nine alerts in ten carry instead of a polygon of their own. The place is put about 0.9 km inside the edge, which is under one cell at either map size, so the picture cannot settle it and the description must. PLAN's own specimen 17 used Grayson County, Kentucky, whose shape is not committed; this scenario uses a shape that is, so it can be rebuilt from the repository alone.
